offers.requirements:
• You’re curious by nature: you look for ways to improve how things work, not just how to get through the queue.

  • You’re calm under pressure, with a positive, solution-driven mindset when things get hectic.

  • You're comfortable being measured on KPIs and performance metrics.

  • You’re a teamplayer: steady, thoughtful, and proactive: the person others know they can count on.

  • You’re fully and perfectly comfortable speaking and writing in English.

  • You’re tech-savy and comfortable with new tools.

  • You see AI as an opportunity to actively look for ways to use it to work faster and better.

  • You’re available to cover morning, evening, and night shifts on weekdays, and on weekends.

Your space to perform

🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset
👩‍💻 Hybrid setup: after 3 months in-office, work 2 days remote, 3 days in-office weekly.
📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget
🇧🇬 Flex Benefits: €70 monthly budget via Re: benefit, offering access to 150+ perks tailored to your lifestyle.
🧳 Digital Nomad Program: After your first year, enjoy up to 20 days per year to work while traveling, combining flexibility with strong team collaboration
🚀 We reward tenure with a dedicated travel budget: €1.5k after 2 years and €3k after 4 years to visit another core office.
💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us
🥦 Delicious lunches from our fabulous in-house chefs with vegan and vegetarian options
⚕️ Private health insurance, just in case
🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style

offers.title: Support Experience Guide

en.description:
As a Support Experience Guide, you're the human expert who steps in when our AI agent Finn needs a helping hand. You don't just fix problems; you make our users feel heard and build trust that lasts. Every interaction isn't just a closed ticket, it's a lesson that makes Finn smarter for next time. Finn is smart, but you're the genius behind the curtain 🤖✨

Take Ownership:

  • Make sure every user feels supported, understood, and never left behind: you'll take over escalated conversations that Finn (our AI assistant) hands off to a human.

  • Get to the root cause of why users needed to reach out at all, and drive fixes that remove the underlying problem: not just close the ticket.

  • Make Finn smarter after every interaction: spot where it fell short, and feed that back so the next Eva gets a better answer.

offers.title: Technical Website Intern

en.description:
Our users lands on bunq.com with one need. If the page is slow, broken, or behaves differently in their browser, they leave. If it's inaccessible, they can't sign up at all. As our Technical Website Intern, you help keep the site underneath fast, accessible, and reliable, so our users find the one proposition that fits their and signs up for exactly what they get.

Up for this? Kick off your application by taking our assessment and find out if bunq is your perfect match! 🚀

Take ownership

As our Technical Website Intern, you'll contribute to Website Growth by strengthening the shared component library behind bunq.com.

  • Clean up deprecated components and duplicated patterns, merging them into single typed components without changing how they look 🧹

  • Fix accessibility, performance, and browser-compatibility defects found by QC before they ever reach Eva 🔧

  • Help keep Core Web Vitals on Good for our key conversion pages ⚡

  • Write the missing tests with Vitest and Playwright, and keep our quality gates green ✅

  • Use AI to move faster, and review what it produces critically before it ships 🤖

  • Learn our stack the right way: React, Framer property controls, atomic design, and design tokens 🧩
en.title: Technical Website Intern

• You have a solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and TypeScript

offers.description:
Our users lands on bunq.com with one need. If the page is slow, broken, or behaves differently in their browser, they leave. If it's inaccessible, they can't sign up at all. As our Technical Website Intern, you help keep the site underneath fast, accessible, and reliable, so our users find the one proposition that fits their and signs up for exactly what they get.

Up for this? Kick off your application by taking our assessment and find out if bunq is your perfect match! 🚀

Take ownership

As our Technical Website Intern, you'll contribute to Website Growth by strengthening the shared component library behind bunq.com.

  • Clean up deprecated components and duplicated patterns, merging them into single typed components without changing how they look 🧹

  • Fix accessibility, performance, and browser-compatibility defects found by QC before they ever reach Eva 🔧

  • Help keep Core Web Vitals on Good for our key conversion pages ⚡

  • Write the missing tests with Vitest and Playwright, and keep our quality gates green ✅

  • Use AI to move faster, and review what it produces critically before it ships 🤖

  • Learn our stack the right way: React, Framer property controls, atomic design, and design tokens 🧩

offers.title: Cards Experience Guide

en.description:
As a Cards Experience Guide, you'll be the person who gives our users peace of mind every time they pay with their bunq card. Whether they need a refund, have a question about a transaction or want to dispute a charge, you'll make sure they get a fast, fair outcome they can count on.

👉 You'll review and issue chargebacks and refunds, handling every case with accuracy and care. Just as important, you'll keep our users informed from start to finish: what's happening, what comes next and if they need to do anything. That way they always feel confident and in control.

Up for this?
Kick off your application by taking our assessment and find out if bunq is your perfect match! 🍭

Take ownership

As our Cards Experience Guide, you'll make the decision on tricky disputes such as incorrect deliveries, ATM issues and partial merchant refunds. Every decision has a real financial impact for our users and for bunq.

  • Resolve chargebacks end-to-end: Investigate each case using transaction data, account history and merchant evidence. Reach a correct, well-reasoned decision within card scheme deadlines.

  • Keep users informed: Send clear, honest and caring updates throughout their case. When we can't approve a dispute, explain why in plain language so they understand it the first time.

  • Work smarter with AI: Use AI tools to research cases, spot patterns in disputes and feedback, and share insights that help the team fix root causes.
